description: All invoices are averaged over. Invoices without line items count as having zero line items and have no mean price.

d.request: Across all invoices (including those with no line items, which count as zero line items and have no mean price), return one row with the average over invoices of each invoice's mean non-missing `product_price` (invoices with no non-missing price are skipped for this mean) and the average number of line items per invoice (counting zero for invoices with none), both unrounded.
d.sql: SELECT (SELECT AVG(m) FROM (SELECT AVG(product_price) AS m FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number HAVING COUNT(product_price) > 0)) AS avg_of_invoice_mean_price, (SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Invoices) FROM Invoice_Line_Items WHERE invoice_number IN (SELECT invoice_number FROM Invoices)) AS avg_line_items_per_invoice

c.request: Per invoice, what is the average of the invoice's mean line-item `product_price` (missing prices ignored; an invoice with no non-missing price has no mean and is skipped), and what is the average number of line items on an invoice? Return a single row with these two values, unrounded. All invoices are averaged over. Invoices without line items count as having zero line items and have no mean price.
c.sql: SELECT (SELECT AVG(m) FROM (SELECT AVG(product_price) AS m FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number HAVING COUNT(product_price) > 0)) AS avg_mean_line_item_price, (SELECT COUNT(*) * 1.0 FROM Invoice_Line_Items) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Invoices) AS avg_line_items_per_invoice

a.request: Across all invoices, including those with no line items, what is the average of each invoice's mean line-item `product_price` (missing prices ignored; an invoice with no non-missing price has no mean and is skipped), and what is the average number of line items per invoice, with an invoice that has no line items counting as zero? Return a single row with these two values, unrounded.

b.request: Across all invoices (including those with no line items, which count as zero line items and have no mean price), return one row with the average of each invoice's mean non-missing line-item product_price (skipping invoices with no non-missing price) and the average number of line items per invoice (counting invoices without line items as 0), both unrounded.
b.sql: SELECT AVG(mean_price) AS avg_mean_price, AVG(cnt * 1.0) AS avg_line_items FROM (SELECT i.invoice_number, AVG(l.product_price) AS mean_price, COUNT(l.invoice_number) AS cnt FROM Invoices i LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items l ON l.invoice_number = i.invoice_number GROUP BY i.invoice_number) t
b.raw: Across all invoices (including those with no line items, which count as zero line items and have no mean price), return one row with the average of each invoice's mean non-missing line-item product_price (skipping invoices with no non-missing price) and the average number of line items per invoice (counting invoices without line items as 0), both unrounded.
